first_stage.normalization: per-coordinate z-score from eligible training sequences only
first_stage.short_sequence_policy: exclude sequences shorter than64 from first-stage training and validation, as in the inherited implementation; retain full available sets in tokenization and final evaluation
first_stage.common_objective: coordinate L2 +0.02 times sum of quantizer commitment losses +0.1 times inherited auxiliary coordinate L2
first_stage.auxiliary_coordinate_slice: flat dimensions4:535, clipped by the actual534-dimensional pose. This is not a temporal velocity loss.
first_stage.model_selection: validation coordinate MSE, with common maximum iteration and early-stopping rules recorded in each run
first_stage.pamvq_revision: use shared decoder and the same encoder widths/fusion architecture as PAMRVQ, with one quantizer per stream. Historical M1 used independent decoders and is not relabelled as this revised model.

second_stage.cap_selection_rule: round up the99.5th percentile of TRAINING sequence lengths to a multiple of64, separately for each dataset. PHX278.705 and CSL298 both give320. No test BLEU used in this choice.
second_stage.truncated_prefix_eos: mask the unobserved terminal target with ignore_index. Do not train an artificial natural EOS at the crop boundary.
second_stage.max_motion_tokens: max_pose_frames / stride_power times group_size: PHX80G, CSL160G
second_stage.model_selection: validation token cross entropy, not test BLEU

decoding.repetition: subtract1.5 from the logits of unique tokens appearing in the last8 positions of the same group
decoding.eos: only after at least one complete group and only at a complete group boundary
decoding.seed_per_sample: SHA256 of fixed generation_seed, dataset, split and sample_id; not model name
decoding.end_reason: record natural EOS separately from pose-frame cap and position-capacity stop

back_translation.model_policy: frozen supplied evaluator weights, no adaptation to revised generated outputs; hashes recorded in each evaluation
back_translation.phix_preprocessing: subsample predictions and reference pose once by2, corresponding to official fps25 input handling
back_translation.csl_preprocessing: no temporal subsampling, as required by the supplied CSL evaluator
back_translation.text_protocol: PHX uses reference/prediction text as the supplied SLRTP metrics consume it. CSL removes literal spaces then separates each character with a space, matching the inherited CSL evaluation wrapper.
back_translation.bleu_implementation: copied SLRTP metrics.py and its vendored external_metrics/sacrebleu.py raw_corpus_bleu
back_translation.sampling_uncertainty: paired bootstrap must consume exactly the same normalized evaluation strings as the main BLEU computation

reporting.new_results_only: Every new figure/table number must be derived from its traceable revised run. Historical values retained in audit files, not silently substituted.
reporting.main_table: training seed42 for all main configurations
reporting.repetition_table: all predeclared training seeds, mean and sample standard deviation
reporting.bootstrap: paired corpus-level resampling of test examples, supplementary sample uncertainty, not a replacement for training repeats
reporting.fairness: same action coverage is not equal token length. E1 matches token count, nominal index bits, code entries and architecture shapes; E2 matches codebook storage, not nominal bits.

publication_note: Public path configuration of separately reported supplementary experiments. Model and sampling semantics are retained.
